hooks.command: f=$(mise -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" exec -- jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/src/*.ts|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/tools/*.ts) mise -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" exec -- npx biome format --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac
mise -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" exec -- node_modules/.bin/biome format --write src tools >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
